correctness.rationale: The standard Petersen graph is reconstructed from explicit \(P(5,2)\) adjacency. A standard-library checker exhausts all 1024 subsets and all 252 five-subsets, verifies the exact coefficient vector, canonicalizes every induced five-vertex subgraph by direct isomorphism, and checks the claimed iff classification. No infinite inference is made from finite data; the theorem itself is finite.
